blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.
blocks.zh: Retrival-augmented generation(RAG)经常将知识图(KGs)集成,用于复杂的多跳问答. 然而,由于知识结构和推理过程,它们的绩效日益受到瓶颈。 (一) 严重的语义损失: 将连续文本分解成离散的符号会剥去背景的细微差别和叙述的连贯性。 (二)发音模式不匹配:断裂图结构与连续文本LLMs相冲突,被预先训练,而将它们重写为自然语言则引入了基因噪声并省略了信息. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用ThreadRAG,这是一个基于语义-地形学的RAG框架,用于上下文保存知识的结构和模式-内在证据推理。 ThreadRAG引入了语义地形图(STM),将检索到的文档组织入上下文-插入语义节点,并通过叙事,语义和词汇边缘来构建语义地形图(STG). 它进一步纳入了能源驱动路径搜索(EDP),通过能量扩散确定与查询有关的子图,并确定将其线性化为一致的文字证据路径。 关于三个多跳QA基准的实验表明,ThreadRAG的业绩始终高于强基线。 值得注意的是,在HotpotQA上,EM比以文字为中心的方法改进了14.4%,在2Wiki Multihop上超过最佳基线5.8%,同时将象征性成本降至最强基线的23.3%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a powerful paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) on knowledge-intensive tasks by grounding generation in external evidence Gao et al. (2023) . However, complex multi-hop question answering (QA) remains challenging for existing RAG systems Lewis et al. (2020) ; Izacard et al. (2022) ; Trivedi et al. (2023) . Unlike single-hop QA, multi-hop QA requires models to identify scattered evidence across multiple documents, connect them through latent relations, and perform multi-step reasoning Shao et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 通过在外部证据Gao等人(2023年)中定位生成,检索增强生成(RAG)已经成为加强知识密集型任务的大型语言模型(LLM)的有力范例。 然而,复杂的多跳问答(QA)对于现有的RAG系统Lewis等人(2020年);Izacard等人(2022年);Trivedi等人(2023年)来说仍然具有挑战性. 与单跳QA不同,多跳QA需要模型在多个文档中识别分散的证据,通过潜伏的关系将其连接起来,并进行多步推理 Shao et al. (2023).

blocks.en: Graph-enhanced RAG methods address this challenge by introducing structural priors over retrieved knowledge. Despite their promise, existing graph-RAG paradigms often suffer from a mismatch between how knowledge is structured and how LLMs perform reasoning. As illustrated in Figure 1 , this mismatch manifests in two key limitations. First, existing graph construction pipelines can incur substantial semantic loss . Triplet-based knowledge graphs compress continuous text into rigid symbolic tuples, often discarding contextual nuances, while chunk-based graphs split documents into isolated segments, leading to semantic truncation and noisy boundaries. Such fragmentation weakens the continuous contextual pathways required for multi-hop reasoning. Second, existing graph representations introduce a modality mismatch at inference time. LLMs are primarily optimized to consume coherent natural language sequences, whereas graph-RAG methods typically provide fragmented graph paths or rely on generative verbalization to convert subgraphs into text. These conversions can introduce redundancy, hallucinated transitions, or omission of critical evidence, thereby limiting the effectiveness of structural priors.
blocks.zh: 图表强化的RAG方法通过在检索到的知识中引入结构前科来解决这一挑战。 现有的图-RAG范式尽管有承诺,但往往在知识的结构与LLMs如何进行推理之间出现不匹配. 如图1所示,这种不匹配表现为两个关键局限。 首先,现有的图建管道可能会发生严重的语义损失。 基于Triplet的知识图将连续的文本压缩成刚性的符号图案,常常丢弃背景细微的细微,而基于块的图案则将文档分割成孤立的片段,导致语义短音和吵闹的边界. 这种分裂削弱了多跳推理所需的连续的环境路径. 第二,现有的图示在推论时间引入一种模式不匹配. LLMS主要优化以消耗连贯的自然语言序列,而图-RAG方法通常提供零散的图路径或依赖基因语言化将子图转换成文字. 这些转换可以引入冗余,幻觉的过渡,或者忽略关键证据,从而限制结构前兆的有效性.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG , a semantic-topology-based RAG framework that preserves textual context during knowledge structuring and converts graph evidence into LLM-native reasoning sequences. ThreadRAG consists of two key components: a S emantic T opology M apper ( STM ) for high-fidelity knowledge structuring, and an E nergy- D riven P athfinding module ( EDP ) for query-aware evidence selection and topological linearization.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议ThreadRAG,一个基于语义的基于语义的RAG框架,在知识结构化过程中保留文字上下文,并将图表证据转换成LLM-内在推理序列. ThreadRAG由两个关键组成部分组成:一个用于高真性知识结构的S emantic T opology M apper(STM),以及一个用于查询-知觉证据选择和地形线性化的E nergy-D riven P athfacting模块(EDP).

blocks.en: A Semantic Topology Mapper for high-fidelity knowledge structuring. To mitigate semantic loss introduced by conventional graph construction, STM structures retrieved documents into an LLM-oriented S emantic T opology G raph ( STG ). Instead of extracting symbolic triplets or relying on isolated chunks, STM organizes retrieved documents into self-contained Semantic Nodes that preserve local textual context. It then connects these nodes through complementary topological relations, including narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. Narrative edges preserve the original textual order, while semantic and lexical edges capture cross-node associations beyond surface adjacency. This design allows STG to retain the semantic continuity of raw text while exposing the relational structure needed for evidence navigation. These relations transform fragmented retrieved evidence into a navigable topology without discarding the natural context required for multi-hop reasoning.
blocks.zh: 用于高真实性知识结构的语义地形图. 为了减轻常规图构造带来的语义损失,STM结构将文件检索到面向LLM的Semantic T opology G raph (STG.)中。 STM没有提取象征性的三重体或依赖孤立块,而是将检索到的文档组织成自成一体的语义节点,保存本地文字上下文. 然后通过互补的地形关系将这些节点连接起来,包括叙事,语义,和词典边缘. 叙述边保留了原始的文字顺序,而语义边和语法边则捕捉到超出表面附位的交叉节点关联. 这种设计允许STG保留原始文本的语义连续性,同时暴露出证据导航所需的关系结构. 这些关系将破碎的检索到的证据转化为可导航的地形,而不放弃多跳推理所需的自然环境.

blocks.en: An Energy-Driven Pathfinding module for modality-native knowledge representation. To bridge the modality mismatch between discrete graph structures and sequence-based LLM reasoning, EDP converts query-relevant topology into continuous textual evidence paths. Given a query, EDP first identifies relevant Semantic Nodes as reasoning anchors, and then performs energy-driven propagation and dynamic pruning over the STG to obtain a compact, query-specific evidence subgraph. Instead of directly prompting the LLM with discrete graph paths or using free-form generation to verbalize the subgraph, EDP deterministically linearizes the selected nodes according to their topological and narrative structure. This process preserves the structural priors of the graph while presenting evidence in a form naturally compatible with LLM pretraining. The resulting Semantic Topology Paths provide continuous, context-preserving, and sequence-native evidence, enabling more coherent and reliable multi-hop reasoning.
blocks.zh: 用于模式内在知识表述的能源驱动路径调查模块。 为了弥合离散的图结构和基于序列的LLM推理之间的模式不匹配,EDP将与查询相关的地形转换为连续的文字证据路径. 由于一个查询,EDP首先将相关的语义节点确定为推理主锚,然后在STG上进行能量驱动的传播和动态浏览,以获得紧凑的,特定查询的证据子图. EDP并没有直接用离散的图表路径提示LLM,或者使用自由形式生成来将子图语言化,而是根据所选节点的地形和叙事结构确定线性化. 这个过程保留了图的结构前缀,同时以与LLM预训自然兼容的形式提出证据. 由此产生的语义地形学路径提供了连续的,上下文的保存,以及序列的内在证据,使得多跳推理更加一致和可靠.

blocks.en: We conduct comprehensive evaluations across three multi-hop QA benchmarks. ThreadRAG consistently surpasses the best mainstream graph-enhanced paradigms across all three datasets (e.g., achieving a 3.4% EM improvement over KnowTrace on HotpotQA). In graph representation evaluations, replacing traditional global graphs with our STG yields a 12.6% EM improvement. Furthermore, our sequence-native STG-Paths strictly dominate all prevailing knowledge representation modalities, peaking at 0.588 EM on 2WikiMultihop. These results indicate that high-fidelity knowledge structuring and topological linearization significantly boost LLM deduction accuracy. Our contributions are as follows:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Semantic Loss in Graph RAG. Integrating KGs into RAG provides explicit structural priors for complex reasoning. Mainstream paradigms like GraphRAG Edge et al. (2024) extract rigid entity-relation triplets, which inadvertently strip away contextual nuances and cause severe semantic loss. To preserve semantics, early NLP QA approaches Fang et al. (2020) ; Qiu et al. (2019) ; Ding et al. (2019) retain original text spans. However, their heterogeneous node designs target GNN aggregation rather than LLM prompt reconstruction, irreversibly fragmenting the logical sequence. To better align with LLMs, recent methods such as HippoRAG Gutiérrez et al. (2024) utilize broader text-chunk nodes. While mitigating symbolic extraction loss, their unconstrained chunk assembly introduces semantic truncation and structural noise. Consequently, these paradigms suffer from semantic loss, depriving LLMs of the continuous contextual pathways essential for multi-hop reasoning. We address this bottleneck by proposing a topological framework that seamlessly embeds structural priors without compromising narrative integrity.
blocks.zh: 图RAG中的语义损失. 将KGs整合到RAG中,为复杂的推理提供了明确的结构前缀. 主流范例如GraphRAG Edge等人(2024年)提取了刚性实体关系三重体,这些三重体无意中剥离了背景细微的细微,并造成了严重的语义损失. 为了保存语义学,早期的NLP QA接近Fang等人(2020年);邱等人(2019年);丁等人(2019年)保留原始文本跨度. 然而,它们多种多样的节点设计针对的是GNN聚合而不是LLM迅速重建,不可逆转地分裂了逻辑序列. 为了更好地与LLMS保持一致,HippoRAG Gutiérrez等人(2024年)等近期方法利用了更广泛的文本结点。 在减轻象征性提取损失的同时,它们的不受约束的块组装引入了语义截断和结构噪声. 因此,这些范式受到语义损失的影响,使LLMS丧失了多跳推理所必需的连续上下文路径. 我们通过提出一个无缝地嵌入结构前题而又不损害叙述完整性的地形框架来解决这一瓶颈。

blocks.en: Modality Alignment in Graph RAG. A critical bottleneck in graph-augmented reasoning is the inherent modality gap between discrete graphs and continuous natural language. Several structural reasoning methods Luo et al. (2024) ; Sun et al. (2024) ; Tan et al. (2025) compel LLMs to process fragmented symbolic data over discrete entity-relation paths. This modality mismatch permanently strips away crucial contextual nuances like temporal constraints. To bridge this, generative rewriting approaches Wu et al. (2024) ; Sarthi et al. (2024) employ LLMs to rewrite subgraphs into natural language, introducing substantial token overhead and hallucination risks. Conversely, chunk-as-node approaches Pham et al. (2026) ; Yue et al. (2026) preserve text spans but merely concatenate nodes as isolated chunks, failing to reconstruct cross-document narrative coherence. ThreadRAG addresses these limitations via a Topological Pathfinding mechanism. Using topological linearization, it restructures fragments into a coherent sequence. This aligns graph topologies with the LLM’s native modality, enabling multi-hop comprehension without generative rewriting overhead.
blocks.zh: 图RAG中的模式对齐。 图解推理中的一个关键瓶颈是离散图和连续自然语言之间的内在模式差距. 几种结构推理方法:Luo等人(2024年);Sun等人(2024年);Tan等人。 (2025)迫使LLMs在离散的实体关系路径上处理零碎的符号数据. 这种模式不匹配永久地消除了时间限制等关键的背景细微差别。 为了弥补这一点,基因重写方法接近Wu等人(2024年);Sarthi等人(2024年)利用LLMs将子图重写为自然语言,引入了大量的象征性俯冲和幻觉风险. 反之,即时整点办法 Pham等人(2026年);Yue等人(2026年)将文本跨度保留下来,但只是将结点作为孤立块,未能重建跨文件的叙述一致性。 ThreadRAG通过地形路径调查机制解决这些局限性。 它利用地形线性化,将碎片重组为连贯的序列. 这使得图表地形与 LLM 的本地模式一致, 能够实现多跳理解, 而无需基因重写 。

blocks.zh: 3 线索RAG

blocks.en: In this section, we present the overall architecture of ThreadRAG (Figure 2 ). The framework primarily consists of an STM module that structures retrieved contexts into an STG (Sec. 3.1 ), a EDP module that extracts and linearizes query-relevant subgraphs into continuous text sequences (Sec. 3.2 ), and an adaptive reasoning agent that iteratively refines the evidence base to synthesize the final answer (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了ThreadRAG的整体架构(图2)。 框架主要包括一个STM模块,其结构检索上下文为STG(Sec. 3.1),一个EDP模块,其提取和线性化了与查询相关的子图成为连续文本序列(Sec. 3.2),以及一个适应性推理剂,其迭代完善证据基础,以合成最终答案(Sec. 3.3).

blocks.en: 3.1 Semantic Topology Mapper
blocks.zh: 3.1 语义地形图

blocks.en: Existing graph-RAG methods fragment continuous texts into discrete components, destroying narrative continuity and inducing severe semantic loss. Motivated by this, our S emantic T opology M apper ( STM ) extracts context-intact semantic nodes and interconnects them via narrative, semantic, and lexical edges into an STG. This fundamentally anchors structural reasoning priors directly into native text sequences, thereby transforming fragmented documents into a high-fidelity network.
blocks.zh: 现有的图-RAG方法将连续文本分割成离散组件,破坏叙事连续性并引起严重的语义损失. 我们的S emantic T opology M apper (STM) 以此为动机,提取了上下文-插入语义节点,并通过叙事,语义,语法边缘将它们连接到STG中. 这从根本上将结构推理前言直接锁定到原生文本序列中,从而将分散的文档转化为高真实性网络.

Our E nergy- D riven P athfinding ( EDP ) module addresses this by executing a context-preserving pathfinding mechanism over the STG. By isolating a query-specific subgraph and deterministically reconstructing it into continuous textual sequences, EDP overcomes structural fragmentation via anchor-driven energy diffusion and topological linearization.

blocks.zh: 3.3 适应性理性剂

blocks.en: The linearized context C C obtained from topological pathfinding is passed to a reasoning agent that iteratively refines its evidence base until the query can be answered with sufficient confidence.
blocks.zh: 从地形路径测量中获得的线性化上下文C C 被传递给一个推理代理商,该推理代理商反复完善其证据基础,直到能够用足够的信心回答询问.

blocks.en: At each iteration, a sufficiency discriminator evaluates the current context C C against the query q q . If C C is deemed sufficient, the agent proceeds directly to answer synthesis; otherwise, the discriminator outputs the missing information as structured knowledge triples, which are forwarded to the sub-query generator to produce targeted retrieval entities. These entities are issued as new queries to the hybrid index, and the retrieved documents are processed through Steps 2–4 of the ThreadRAG pipeline—segmentation, graph augmentation, and topological pathfinding—to yield a refined context C ′ C^{\prime} that replaces C C for the next iteration.
blocks.zh: 在每次迭代时,一个充分性歧视者会对照查询q q评价当前上下文C C. 如果CC被认为足够,则代理直接去回答合成;否则,歧视者将缺失的信息输出为结构化的知识三重体,这些三重体被传送到子干流生成器,生成目标检索实体. 这些实体作为对混合指数的新查询发布,检索到的文件通过ThreadRAG管道的第2-4步处理——分块、图加成和地形路径查找——以产生一个精细的上下文C ' C^{\prime],取代C,供下一个迭代使用。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en: Datasets & Metrics. We evaluate ThreadRAG on three standard open-domain multi-hop QA benchmarks: HotpotQA Yang et al. (2018) , 2WikiMultihopQA Ho et al. (2020) , and MuSiQue Trivedi et al. (2022) . We use the same data splits as previous works Trivedi et al. (2023) ; Li and Du (2023) for evaluation. Following IRCoT Trivedi et al. (2023) , our retrieval corpus aggregates all supporting and distractor passages to simulate a realistic open-domain setting. For evaluation, we report Exact Match (EM) and F1 scores to measure absolute correctness and token-level overlap, applying standard text normalization to both predictions and ground-truth answers prior to computation.
blocks.zh: 数据集与计量. 我们评价 ThreadRAG 三个标准的开放域多跳QA基准: HotpotQA Yang等人(2018年),2 Wiki MultihopQA Ho等人(2020年),以及MuSiQue Trivedi等人(2022年). 我们使用与之前的作品Trivedi等人(2023年);李和杜(2023年)相同的数据分割来进行评估. 继IRCoT Trivedi等人(2023年)之后,我们的检索程序汇总了所有支持和分散注意力的通道,以模拟一个现实的开放域设置。 对于评价,我们报告精确匹配(EM)和F1的分数,以衡量绝对正确性和符号级重叠,在计算前对预测和地面真实答案应用标准文本正常化.

blocks.en: Baselines. We evaluate ThreadRAG against five categories of baselines: text-centric multi-hop methods reasoning purely over plain text (RA-CoT Wei et al. (2022) , ReAct Yao et al. (2022) , IRCoT Trivedi et al. (2023) , Self-Ask Press et al. (2023) , Iter-RetGen Shao et al. (2023) ), KG-Chunk RAG methods treating text chunks as nodes (HippoRAG Gutiérrez et al. (2024) , LightRAG Guo et al. (2024) ), KG-Rewriting RAG methods converting subgraphs into natural language (CoTKR Wu et al. (2024) , EFSUM Ko et al. (2024) ), KG-Path RAG methods reasoning along discrete structural paths (ToG Sun et al. (2024) , PoG Tan et al. (2025) ), and KG-Triplet RAG methods prompting with discrete relational triplets (ERA-CoT Liu et al. (2024) , KnowTrace Li et al. (2025) ). For fair comparison, we adapt ToG and PoG to use the same local KG as LightRAG, replacing their external KGs.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We use Llama-3-8B Grattafiori et al. (2024) , Qwen-3.5-Plus Yang et al. (2025) , and GPT-4o-mini OpenAI et al. (2024) with nomic-embed-text for embeddings Nussbaum et al. (2024) . Chunk size is 1200 characters with 150 overlap. We retrieve top-5 global contexts via Elasticsearch using equal BM25 and dense weights. STG settings are: 5-NN, 0.5/0.3 semantic/lexical thresholds, and edge weights γ = 0.3 \gamma=0.3 , α = 0.35 \alpha=0.35 , β = 0.65 \beta=0.65 . Pathfinding parameters are: 3 anchors, 0.5 PPR restart, 0.01 pruning threshold, and 3 max iterations. All experiments run on 4 NVIDIA A6000 GPUs.

blocks.en: 4.2 Inference Performance Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.2 推断性能比较

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the main experimental results across three multi-hop QA datasets. First, we observe that KG-Chunk methods (e.g., HippoRAG) outperform KG-Rewriting approaches to a certain extent (e.g., CoTKR, achieving 0.324 vs. 0.304 EM on HotpotQA with LLaMA3-8B-Instruct). We attribute this to the generative noise and hallucinations introduced when rewriting discrete subgraphs into text. Second, iterative KG-Triplet prompting (e.g., KnowTrace) significantly surpasses KG-Path methods (e.g., PoG, 0.396 vs. 0.336 EM). This indicates that faulty path retrieval can easily inject erroneous logical chains, which LLMs struggle to verify or reject due to the severe loss of surrounding narrative context in discrete nodes.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了三个多跳QA数据集的主要实验结果. 首先,我们观察到KG-Chunk方法(如HippoRAG)在一定程度上超过了KG-重写方法(如CoTKR,在热点QA上用LLaMA3-8B-Instruct实现0.324对0.304EM). 我们将此归因于在将离散子图重写成文本时引入的基因噪声和幻觉. 第二,迭代的KG-Triplet提示(如KnowTrace)大大超过KG-Path方法(如PoG,0.396对0.336 EM). 这表明错误路径检索可以很容易地注入错误的逻辑链,LLMs由于离散节点中严重丢失周围的叙事上下文而难以验证或拒绝.

blocks.en: Beyond these flawed paradigms, ThreadRAG directly grounds structural guidance within native text sequences to achieve state-of-the-art results. For example, it outperforms the strongest baseline KnowTrace, by up to 5.8% EM on 2Wiki (GPT-4o mini). Furthermore, it surpasses the text-centric IRCoT by a substantial 14.4% EM on the complex HotpotQA dataset (Qwen3.5 plus). These significant gains demonstrate the effectiveness of our STG in providing high-fidelity structural priors. By providing explicit reasoning pathways without fragmenting the original narrative flow, ThreadRAG bridges the modality gap, bypassing both the semantic loss of symbolic extraction and the hallucination risks of generative rewriting.
blocks.zh: 除了这些有缺陷的范式外,ThreadRAG直接将结构指导置于原生文本序列内,以实现最先进的结果. 例如,它的表现超过了最强基线KnowTrace,在2Wiki(GPT-4o迷你)上达到5.8%的EM. 此外,在复杂的HotpotQA数据集(Quen3.5 +)上,它比以文字为中心的IRCoT高14.4%的EM。 这些重大进展表明我们的科技小组在提供高可靠性结构前科方面的效力。 ThreadRAG通过提供明确的推理路径而不分割原始的叙事流,弥合了模式间隙,绕过了符号提取的语义损失和基因重写产生的幻觉风险.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation study of the STM (SN, STG) and EDP modules across three datasets.
blocks.zh: 表2:跨越三个数据集的STM(SN,STG)和EDP模块的偏差研究.

blocks.en: Many unexplored questions surround the optimal knowledge representation and reasoning modalities for multi-hop QA. In this section, we conduct an extensive ablation study to validate the core components of ThreadRAG and summarize key findings.
blocks.zh: 许多未经探讨的问题围绕着多跳QA的最佳知识表现和推理模式. 在本节中,我们进行了广泛的消化研究,以验证ThreadRAG的核心组成部分,并总结关键的调查结果.

blocks.en: The STM preserves crucial contextual integrity. As shown in Table 2 , removing the entire STM module (i.e., SN and STG) and using LLM-extracted triplets leads to a severe decline in performance, with the EM score dropping by 9.2% on MuSiQue. Furthermore, replacing our MLP-based Semantic Nodes (SN) with fixed-length chunks results in a noticeable 3.4% drop on HotpotQA. We attribute this to the fact that traditional triplet extraction or arbitrary chunking inevitably destroys the continuous narrative flow, resulting in irreversible semantic loss that hinders the LLM’s ability to deduce complex answers.
blocks.zh: 标准管理办法保持了关键的背景完整性。 如表2所示,移除整个STM模块(即SN和STG)并使用LLM提取的三胞胎导致性能严重下降,在MuSiQue上EM分数下降9.2%. 此外,用固定长度块取代我们的基于MLP的语义节点(SN)会导致热点QA的明显下降3.4%。 我们将此归因于一个事实,即传统的三重提取或任意的分割不可避免地会破坏持续的叙事流,造成不可逆转的语义损失,从而阻碍LLM推断复杂答案的能力.

blocks.en: EDP effectively bridges the modality gap. As shown in Table 2 , feeding the discrete STG nodes directly into the LLM without the EDP module’s topological linearization causes a noticeable decline, such as an 3.8% decrease on the MuSiQue dataset. We attribute this to the inherent modality mismatch between discrete graph structures and the LLM’s native continuous language space. Without EDP to reconstruct the narrative sequence, the LLM struggles to effectively interpret the fragmented subgraphs, which introduces reasoning noise and degrades overall performance.
blocks.zh: 电子发展方案有效地弥合了模式差距。 如表2所示,在没有EDP模块的地形线性化的情况下,将离散的STG节点直接输入LLM会导致显著下降,例如MuSiQue数据集下降3.8%。 我们将此归因于离散图结构与LLM本土连续语言空间之间的内在模式不匹配。 没有EDP来重建叙事序列,LLM就挣扎于有效解释支离破碎的子图,这引入了推理噪声,降低了整体性能.

blocks.en: 4.4 More Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 更多分析

blocks.en: Cost Analysis. To quantify the computational overhead, we measure token consumption across 100 randomly sampled queries per dataset using the tiktoken library (GPT-4o-mini standard). As shown in Table 3 , ThreadRAG demonstrates a decisive advantage in computational efficiency by fundamentally decoupling structural knowledge generation from expensive LLM pre-computation across all datasets. In contrast, baseline methods like LightRAG and KnowTrace consume massive token budgets—up to 36.4M and 220K tokens, respectively—merely to build their graph structures. Furthermore, when evaluating the overall pipeline, ThreadRAG operates highly efficiently: its total token consumption accounts for merely 23.3% to 26.3% of the overhead incurred by the strongest baseline, KnowTrace. This confirms that ThreadRAG effectively resolves the prohibitive I/O bottlenecks inherent in traditional graph-enhanced RAG paradigms.
blocks.zh: 成本分析。 为了量化计算间接费用,我们用tiktoken库(GPT-4o-mini标准)测量每个数据集100个随机抽样查询的象征性消耗。 如表3所示,ThreadRAG通过在所有数据集中从根本上将结构知识生成与昂贵的LLM预计算脱钩,显示出计算效率的决定性优势. 与此相反,LightRAG和KnowTraces等基线方法消耗大量象征性预算——分别高达36.4M和220K令牌——只是为了构建其图表结构。 此外,在评估整个管道时,ThreadRAG的运行效率很高:其总的象征性消费只占最强基线(KnowTrace)发生的间接费用的23.3%至26.3%。 这证实了ThreadRAG有效地解决了传统图增强RAG范式中固有的令人望而却步的I/O瓶颈.

blocks.en: Hyperparameter analysis. To evaluate framework robustness, we conduct a hyperparameter analysis on the HotpotQA dataset using the GPT-4o-mini model. As illustrated in Figure 3 , we investigate four key variables: initial anchors, retrieved documents, reasoning iterations, and the energy pruning threshold ( ϵ \epsilon ). ThreadRAG demonstrates remarkable stability, consistently maintaining Exact Match (EM) scores above 0.512 across all extreme settings. Performance optimally peaks at an EM of 0.574 with 3 anchors, 5 documents, 3 iterations, and a 0.01 threshold. Notably, exceeding these values yields marginal diminishing returns rather than sharp performance drops. This confirms ThreadRAG effectively balances computational efficiency with reasoning accuracy, avoiding unnecessary over-exploration.
blocks.zh: 超参数分析。 为了评价框架的稳健性,我们利用GPT-4o-mini模型对HotpotQA数据集进行了超参数分析。 如图3所示,我们调查了四个关键变量:初始主锚、检索的文件、推理迭代和能量推移阈值(QQ\\epsilon )。 ThreadRAG表现出显著的稳定性,在所有极端环境下始终保持精确匹配(EM)的分数高于0.512。 性能最佳高峰为0.574的EM,有3个锚,5个文件,3个迭代,以及0.01个阈值. 值得注意的是,超过这些数值的回报率略有下降,而不是急剧下降。 这证实了 ThreadRAG有效地平衡了计算效率与推理准确性,避免了不必要的过度探索.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Performance comparison of EM scores using different underlying graph representations.
blocks.zh: 图 4:使用不同基础图表表述对EM分数进行性能比较.

blocks.en: Graph Representation Comparison. This experiment compares the conventional GraphRAG paradigm, which relies on the strict extraction of rigid entity-relation triplets, against our STG paradigm, which inherently preserves native semantic context and narrative flow. To facilitate a rigorous evaluation, we implement two specific variants: GraphRAG ∗ , which utilizes a pre-constructed global KG, and ThreadRAG ∗ , which adopts our proposed Semantic Topology Graph. All other components, including retrieval indices and prompting templates, are kept strictly identical.
blocks.zh: 图表代表性比较。 这个实验比较了传统的GraphRAG范式,这个范式依赖于严格提取刚性实体关系三重体,与我们的STG范式相对应,后者本质上保留了本土语义背景和叙事流. 为了便于进行严格的评估,我们采用了两个具体的变体:GraphRAG ∗,它使用一个预先构建的全球KG,以及ThreadRAG ∗,它采用了我们提议的语义地形图。 所有其他组成部分,包括检索指数和提示模板,都严格相同。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 4 , ThreadRAG ∗ consistently achieves superior performance across all benchmarks, securing substantial EM improvements ranging from 7.8% to 12.6%. Notably, on the HotpotQA dataset, our approach yields a significant 12.6% improvement in EM (from 0.288 to 0.414). We attribute these substantial gains to STG’s ability to preserve rich semantic narrative flows and ensure precise modality alignment via topological paths. In contrast, the discrete, symbolic triplets employed by GraphRAG ∗ tend to fragment the original context, leading to inevitable semantic loss during complex multi-hop reasoning.
blocks.zh: 如图4所示, ThreadRAG * 在所有基准中一贯取得优异业绩,确保了从7.8%到12.6%的重大EM改善。 值得注意的是,在热点QA数据集方面,我们的方法在EM中取得了12.6%的显著改善(从0.288提高到0.414)。 我们把这些巨大的收益归结于STG保存丰富的语义叙事流和通过地形路径确保精确模式对齐的能力. 与此相反,GraphRAG *所使用的离散的,象征性的三重体往往会分裂原来的上下文,导致复杂多跳推理过程中不可避免的语义损失.

blocks.en: knowledge representation strategies. Since a critical concern lies in how to optimally format retrieved knowledge for LLM inference, we investigate four knowledge representation strategies: KG-Triplets, KG-Paths, KG-Texts, and our STG-Paths, respectively corresponding to discrete relational triplets, linear structural paths, LLM-rewritten natural language, and topological text paths. As illustrated in Figure 5 , STG-Paths consistently achieves the highest performance. We observe that forcing an LLM to rewrite triplets into natural language (KG-Texts) occasionally underperforms even naive KG-Triplets, which we attribute to hallucinations and semantic distortions introduced during rewriting. Conversely, while KG-Triplets and KG-Paths avoid rewriting risks, they suffer from severe semantic fragmentation and lack deep structural context. In stark contrast, STG-Paths resolves this dilemma. By directly extracting topological text paths, it preserves undistorted raw information while injecting structural priors. This dual advantage of strict semantic fidelity and logical coherence renders STG-Paths the most effective representation for our framework.
blocks.zh: 知识表达战略。 由于一个关键的关切在于如何为LLM推论最佳格式化检索到的知识,我们调查了四个知识表达策略:KG-Triplets,KG-Paths,KG-Texts,以及我们的STG-Paths,分别对应离散关系三重体,线性结构路径,LLM-重写自然语言,以及地形文字路径. 如图5所示,STG-Paths的成绩始终是最高的。 我们观察到强迫一个LLM将三胞胎重写为自然语言(KG-Texts)有时甚至表现不佳,我们将此归咎于在重写过程中引入的幻觉和语义扭曲. 反之,虽然KG-Triplets和KG-Paths避免了重写风险,但它们遭受严重的语义分裂,缺乏深层结构背景. 与此形成鲜明对比的是,STG-Paths解决了这一困境. 它通过直接提取地形文字路径,在注入结构前缀的同时保存未分解的原始信息. 严格的语义忠诚和逻辑一致性的双重优势使得STG-Paths成为我们框架最有效的代表.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose ThreadRAG to tackle complex multi-hop reasoning challenges. ThreadRAG integrates a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) for knowledge structuring and a Modality-Aligned Reasoning Mechanism via Energy-Driven pathfinding. As a core contribution, ThreadRAG linearizes discrete graph structures into continuous natural language sequences, effectively bridging the modality gap and preserving crucial narrative context. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that ThreadRAG achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks, surpassing existing state-of-the-art baselines with low computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提议ThreadRAG应对复杂的多跳推理挑战. ThreadRAG整合了用于知识结构的语义地形图(STG),并通过能源驱动路径的查找,整合了Modality-Reaction理据机制. 作为一种核心贡献,ThreadRAG将离散的图表结构线性化成连续的自然语言序列,有效弥合模式间隙,保留关键叙事背景. 广泛的实验结果表明,ThreadRAG在多个基准中取得了优异的业绩,超过了现有最新基线,计算间接费用较低。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our work has limitations in certain scenarios. First, ThreadRAG relies on capturing structural priors through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges, so its performance improvement may not be significant in tasks with extremely sparse document links or where cross-document evidence chains are virtually non-existent, such as single-document standard QA tasks. Additionally, due to the dynamic nature of text segmentation and the complexity of multi-hop paths, even after energy diffusion and graph pruning, there may still be a few long-range contextual dependencies that the pathfinding mechanism fails to perfectly linearize in the exact chronological or logical order. This could result in minor narrative fragmentation during prompt reconstruction, affecting the reasoning accuracy of downstream LLMs. In future work, we aim to address these two issues. We plan to explore whether the model can effectively optimize the topological path selection and conduct a more fine-grained alignment of narrative flows to further enhance the effectiveness of LLM prompts.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作在某些情况下是有局限性的。 首先,ThreadRAG依赖于通过叙事,语义,语法边缘来捕捉结构前缀,因此其性能的改进在文件链接极其稀少的任务中可能并不显著,或者跨文件证据链几乎不存在,比如单文件标准QA任务. 此外,由于文本分割的动态性质和多跳路径的复杂性,即使在能量扩散和图表循环之后,仍然可能有一些长距离的上下文依赖性,路径查找机制未能按照准确的时间顺序或逻辑顺序完全线性化. 这可能在迅速重建期间造成叙述上的细微分裂,影响下游有限责任公司推理的准确性。 在今后的工作中,我们的目标是解决这两个问题。 我们计划探索该模型是否能够有效优化地形路径选择,并对叙事流进行更精细的调整,以进一步提高LLM提示的有效性.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work uses only publicly available benchmark datasets, including HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue, and does not involve the collection of personally identifiable or sensitive information, human-subject experiments, or user studies. All datasets and pretrained models are used solely for academic research and evaluation purposes in accordance with their intended licenses and usage conditions.
blocks.zh: 这部作品只使用公开提供的基准数据集,包括HotpotQA,2Wiki MultihopQA,和MuSiQue,不涉及个人可识别或敏感信息的收集,人主体实验,或用户研究. 所有数据集和经过预先培训的模型都根据预定的许可证和使用条件,仅用于学术研究和评价目的。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集细节

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the multi-hop reasoning and knowledge structuring capabilities of ThreadRAG, we conduct our experiments across three standard benchmarks. Detailed descriptions of each dataset are provided below:
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估ThreadRAG的多跳推理和知识结构能力,我们通过三个标准基准进行实验。 各数据集的详细说明如下:

blocks.en: HotpotQA Yang et al. (2018) is a widely-used, crowd-sourced dataset derived from English Wikipedia, comprising approximately 113k questions. It specifically requires models to bridge information across the introductory paragraphs of multiple distinct articles to deduce the correct answer. While the original dataset provides golden paragraphs and human-annotated supporting sentences, we evaluate our framework strictly under a realistic open-domain setting. In this setting, golden contexts are not provided a priori ; instead, the system must retrieve and structure relevant information from a massive corpus, which rigorously tests the robustness of our Semantic Topology Graph (STG) against retrieval noise and distractors.
blocks.zh: 热点QA Yang et al. (2018)是一个广泛使用,来自英语维基百科的众源数据集,包含约113k个问题. 它特别要求模型在多个不同条款的导言段落之间连接信息,以推断出正确的答案。 虽然原始数据集提供了黄金段落和人为附加说明的辅助句子,但我们严格在现实的开放域设置下评估我们的框架. 在这种背景下,黄金背景没有被预先提供;相反,该系统必须检索和整理一个大型实体的相关信息,这严格地检验我们语义地形图(STG)的稳健性,以对抗检索噪音和分散注意力者。

blocks.en: 2WikiMultihopQA (2Wiki) Ho et al. (2020) focuses on evaluating complex 2-hop reasoning, placing a strong emphasis on compositional deduction and comparative analysis. The questions in this dataset are systematically constructed by combining both structured knowledge (from Wikidata) and unstructured texts (from Wikipedia). This structural heterogeneity makes it an ideal testbed for evaluating whether our framework can seamlessly align and linearize varied knowledge formats into a cohesive, modality-native narrative flow without semantic loss.
blocks.zh: 2Wiki MultihopQA(2Wiki)Ho et al. (2020)专注于评价复杂的2-hop推理,大力强调成分推理和比较分析. 本数据集中的问题通过将结构化的知识(来自维基数据)和未结构化的文本(来自维基百科)结合起来来系统地构建. 这种结构的异质性使它成为一个理想的测试台,用来评价我们的框架是否能够将各种知识格式无缝地对齐和线性化,形成一个连贯的,模式-内在的叙述流而不失去语义.

blocks.en: MuSiQue Trivedi et al. (2022) is a highly demanding dataset carefully constructed by composing bottom-up single-hop queries into intricate multi-hop reasoning chains. Compared to HotpotQA and 2Wiki, MuSiQue poses a significantly greater challenge as it features deep 2- to 4-hop questions and is meticulously designed to prevent reasoning shortcuts. This dataset effectively stress-tests the capability of our Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP) mechanism to maintain long-range logical coherence and prevent structural truncation in extremely deep reasoning scenarios.
blocks.zh: MuSiQue Trivedi等人(2022年)是通过将自下而上的单跳查询组合成复杂的多跳推理链来精心构建的高度要求数据集. 与HotpotQA和2Wiki相比,MuSiQue的难度要大得多,因为它的特征是深层的2-4-hop问题,并且精心设计以防止推理快捷键. 这个数据集有效地测试了我们的能源驱动路径测量(EDP)机制在极端深层推理情景中保持远程逻辑一致性和防止结构断裂的能力.

blocks.en: Appendix B Baseline Descriptions
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate the performance of ThreadRAG and clearly demonstrate the characteristics of different knowledge representation paradigms, we benchmark our framework against five distinct categories of state-of-the-art baselines.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评价ThreadRAG的绩效,并清楚地展示不同知识代表范式的特点,我们以五个不同类别的最新基线作为我们框架的基准。

blocks.en: Non-Graph RAG. This category encompasses text-centric paradigms that tackle multi-hop reasoning over plain text without relying on explicit graph structures. Instead of using structural priors, these approaches lean heavily on the LLM’s intrinsic capacity to process continuous contexts and deduce logical chains. To evaluate this paradigm, we select several prominent baselines: RA-CoT Wei et al. (2022) and ReAct Yao et al. (2022) , which enhance standard text reasoning by integrating retrieval with chain-of-thought and acting, respectively; IRCoT Trivedi et al. (2023) and Iter-RetGen Shao et al. (2023) , which build continuous reasoning chains by iteratively interleaving retrieval steps with generation; and Self-Ask Press et al. (2023) , which structures the context by decomposing complex queries into manageable textual sub-queries.
blocks.zh: 非Graph RAG (英语). 这一类别包括以文字为中心的范式,这些范式处理多跳推理而不是纯文本,而不依赖明确的图表结构。 这些办法不是使用结构前科,而是大量依赖LLM处理连续环境和推断逻辑链的内在能力。 为了评估这一模式,我们选择了几个突出的基线:RA-CoT Wei et al. (2022)和ReAct Yao et al. (2022),它们分别通过将检索与思维链和行为链相结合,加强了标准文本推理; IRCoT Trivedi et al. (2023)和Iter-RetGen Shao et al. (2023),它们通过迭代连接检索步骤与生成建立连续的推理链; Self-Ask Press et al. (2023),它们通过将复杂的查询分解为可管理的文本子序列来构建上下文.

blocks.en: KG-Chunk RAG. Methods in this paradigm aim to mitigate the semantic fragmentation caused by fine-grained triplet extraction by treating larger text chunks as the fundamental nodes in the knowledge graph. This approach provides structural connectivity while preserving local contextual nuances. We evaluate against HippoRAG Gutiérrez et al. (2024) , a neurobiologically inspired framework simulating human long-term memory, and LightRAG Guo et al. (2024) , which focuses on simple, fast, and lightweight graph-based retrieval.
blocks.zh: KG-Chunk RAG. (英语). 这一范式中的方法旨在通过将较大的文本块作为知识图中的基本节点来减轻精细的三重提取引起的语义分裂. 这种方法提供结构连通性,同时保留当地背景的细微差别。 我们对照HippoRAG Gutiérrez等人(2024年)和LightRAG Guo等人(2024年)来评价,后者是一个以神经生物为启发的模拟人类长期记忆的框架,后者侧重于简单、快速和轻量级的图表检索。

blocks.en: KG-Rewriting RAG. Recognizing the modality mismatch between discrete graph structures and the continuous text sequences LLMs are pre-trained on, this category attempts to bridge the gap through generative rewriting. These methods retrieve relevant subgraphs and employ LLMs to translate them into natural language narratives prior to final reasoning. Representative baselines include CoTKR Wu et al. (2024) , which enhances knowledge rewriting via chain-of-thought, and EFSUM Ko et al. (2024) , which focuses on generating evidence-focused summaries from graph structures.
blocks.zh: KG重写RAG. 认识到离散的图结构与连续的文本序列之间的模式不匹配,LLMs被预先训练,这一类试图通过基因重写来弥补差距. 这些方法检索相关的子图,并在最终推理前使用LLMS将其翻译为自然语言的叙事. 具有代表性的基线包括COTKR Wu等人(2024年),后者通过思维链加强知识重写;EFSUM Ko等人(2024年),后者侧重于从图表结构中生成注重证据的摘要。

blocks.en: KG-Path RAG. This paradigm provides LLMs with explicit, step-by-step structural guidance by forcing them to reason along discrete relational paths extracted from the knowledge graph. The selected baselines are Think-on-Graph ( ToG ) Sun et al. (2024) and Paths-over-Graph ( PoG ) Tan et al. (2025) . For fair comparison, we adapt ToG and PoG to use the same local KG as LightRAG, replacing their external KGs.
blocks.zh: KG-Path RAG (英语). 这种范式为LLMS提供了明确,逐步的结构指导,迫使它们沿着从知识图中提取的离散关系路径进行推理. 选定基线为“思考与图形” Sun等人(2024年)和Paths-over-Graph (PoG.) Tan et al. (2025) (英语). 为了进行公平的比较,我们改造了ToG和PoG,以使用与LightRAG相同的本地KG,取代他们的外部KG.

blocks.en: KG-Triplet RAG. Representing the most fine-grained end of the structural extraction spectrum, these methods distill documents into rigid entity-relation triplets and use them as discrete prompts. While offering high-density factual associations, this paradigm often strips away the original narrative context entirely. We compare against ERA-CoT Liu et al. (2024) , which improves reasoning through entity relationship analysis, and KnowTrace Li et al. (2025) , a robust iterative framework guided by structured knowledge tracing.
blocks.zh: KG-Triplet RAG. (英语). 这些方法代表了结构提取光谱中最精细的一端,将文件蒸馏成刚性的实体关系三重体,并用作离散的导体. 这种范式虽然提供了高密度的事实关联,但往往将原始的叙事背景完全剥离. 我们比较了ERA-CoT Liu等人(2024年)和KnowTrace Li等人(2025年),前者通过实体关系分析改进了推理,后者是一个以结构化知识追踪为指导的强有力的迭代框架。

blocks.en: Appendix D Implementation Details of the Semantic Segmentation Model
blocks.zh: 附录D 执行情况 语义分裂模型的细节

blocks.en: In response to the necessity for high-fidelity, context-intact partitioning during the Semantic Topology Mapper (STM) phase, we explicitly detail the architecture, data curation, and training pipeline of the MLP-based boundary predictor (introduced in Equation 2).
blocks.zh: 为了响应在语义地形图(STM)阶段进行高纯度,上下文插入分割的必要性,我们明确详细介绍了基于MLP的边界预测器(引入于方程式2)的架构,数据校准和培训管道.

blocks.en: Encoder Architecture and Inference Pipeline. The “lightweight encoder” utilized in our framework is implemented using the pre-trained RoBERTa-base model. To prepare the inputs, raw continuous documents are first segmented into natural sentences using the NLTK library. To maximize contextual awareness while strictly adhering to the 512-token limit of the RoBERTa architecture, we dynamically pack consecutive sentences into continuous blocks of under 512 tokens. The model processes these text blocks to extract dense representations, simultaneously evaluating the semantic continuity at the boundaries between all adjacent sentences within the chunk. This batch-processing approach provides a robust foundation for capturing localized semantic shifts without incurring the massive latency associated with using LLMs for real-time inference. During generation, a semantic breakpoint is formally triggered if the predicted boundary probability p i p_{i} exceeds a confidence threshold of θ = 0.65 \theta=0.65 .
blocks.zh: 编码器建筑与推论管道. 我们的框架使用的“轻量级编码器”是使用经过预先培训的RoBERTa基模型实施的。 为了准备输入,原始连续文件首先使用NLTK库分解成自然句子. 为了最大限度地提高背景意识,同时严格遵守RoBERTA架构的512托肯限制,我们动态地将连续句子打入512个令牌以下的连续块. 模型处理这些文本块以提取稠密的表示,同时评价块内所有相邻句子的边界上的语义连续性. 这种批量处理办法为捕捉局部语义变化提供了坚实基础,同时又不至于因实时推论使用法学硕士而产生巨大延迟。 生成期间,如果预测的边界概率p i p _{i } 超过 θ = 0.65\theta= 0.65 的置信阈值,则正式触发语义断点.

blocks.en: Data and Supervision Signal (Silver Labels). To circumvent the prohibitive costs of human annotation while maintaining high segmentation quality, we employ a Knowledge Distillation (KD) paradigm using pseudo-labels (Silver Labels). Specifically, we sample 100 complex multi-hop documents from the Wikipedia corpus. We then prompt powerful teacher models (e.g., GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3.5-Plus) to perform rigorous "Semantic Node Partitioning" on this subset, instructing them to split the texts along natural narrative breaks. This zero-shot distillation yields a high-quality dataset comprising 1,553 distinct semantic nodes. The binary boundaries generated by these teacher models serve as the positive supervision signals ( y i = 1 y_{i}=1 for a narrative boundary, y i = 0 y_{i}=0 for continuous context) to train our lightweight boundary predictor.
blocks.zh: 数据与监管信号(银质标签). 为了在保持高分化质量的同时避免人类注解的高昂成本,我们采用了使用伪标签(Silver Labels)的知识分解(KD)范式. 具体来说,我们从维基百科中提取了100个复杂的多跳文件。 然后,我们促使强大的教师模型(例如GPT-4o-mini和Quen3.5-Plus)在这个子集上进行严格的"语义节点分拆",指示他们按照自然的叙事分解文字. 这种零射蒸馏产生高质量的数据集,由1,553个不同的语义节点组成. 这些师范模型产生的二进制边框作为正导导信号(y i = 1 y _{i}=i}=1 用于叙述边框,y i = 0 y _{i}=0 用于连续上下文)来训练我们的轻量级边框预测器.

blocks.en: Generalizability (Shared Across Datasets). It is crucial to note that the segmentation model is not dynamically re-trained or overfitted to individual evaluation sets. The RoBERTa-base encoder and the MLP head are trained exactly once using the distilled pseudo-labels. The resulting weights are then frozen and uniformly shared across all downstream evaluations (HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, and MuSiQue). This zero-shot inference approach ensures strict evaluation fairness and proves that our STM possesses strong generalization capabilities across unseen open-domain texts.
blocks.zh: 通用性(跨数据集共享). 必须指出的是,分块模式没有动态地重新培训,也没有过度适应各套评价。 RoBERTa基编码器和MLP头被精确地用蒸馏的伪标签训练过一次. 由此产生的权重随后被冻结,并统一分享到所有下游评价中(HotpotQA,2Wiki MultihopQA,和MuSiQue)。 这种零射线推论方法确保了严格的评价公平性,并证明我们的《标准手册》在无形的开放域文本中具有强大的通用能力。

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Ablation and Intrinsic Evaluation
blocks.zh: 附录E 补充性和内在性评价

blocks.en: To further address the concerns regarding graph topology, evidence selection, and semantic segmentation, we conduct additional controlled ablations and intrinsic evaluations. These experiments complement the main-text analyses by more explicitly isolating the contributions of graph-based evidence organization, Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), and the semantic boundary predictor.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步解决对图表地形、证据选择和语义分类的关切,我们进行了更多的有控制的拼贴和内在评价。 这些实验通过更明确地隔离以图表为基础的证据组织、能源驱动路径测量(EDP)和语义边界预测器的贡献来补充主文分析。

blocks.en: E.1 Graph-Free Ablation
blocks.zh: E.1 无图解析

blocks.en: To more cleanly isolate the contribution of graph-based evidence organization from the remaining components of ThreadRAG, we construct a Graph-Free variant. This variant retains the same retrieval pipeline, iterative reasoning procedure, downstream LLM, prompts, and evidence budget as ThreadRAG, while removing Semantic Topology Graph (STG) construction and EDP. Instead, retrieved passages are selected according to query–passage similarity and concatenated following their original document order.
blocks.zh: 为了将基于图表的证据组织的贡献与ThreadRAG的其余组件更清洁地隔离开来,我们构建了一个无图表变体. 这个变体保留了与ThreadRAG相同的检索管道,迭代推理程序,下游LM,提示,以及证据预算,同时去除语义地形图(STG)构造和EDP. 相反,检索到的段落是根据查询-通道相似性选择的,并按原始文件顺序进行调适。

blocks.en: Table 6: Controlled Graph-Free ablation in terms of Exact Match (EM). The Graph-Free variant preserves retrieval and iterative reasoning while removing graph construction and EDP.
blocks.zh: 表6: 精确匹配(EM)方面受控的无图纪。 Graph-Free变体保留了检索和迭代推理,同时删除了图表构造和EDP.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , removing graph-based evidence organization leads to consistent absolute EM decreases of 0.148, 0.114, and 0.118 on HotpotQA, 2Wiki, and MuSiQue, respectively. These results indicate that the performance gain of ThreadRAG cannot be attributed solely to iterative retrieval or reasoning, and that explicitly organizing retrieved evidence through the semantic topology contributes substantially to multi-hop reasoning performance.
blocks.zh: 如表6所示,去除以图表为基础的证据组织导致HotpotQA,2Wiki和MuSiQue上EM的绝对值分别持续下降0.148,0.114和0.118. 这些结果表明,ThreadRAG的性能收益不能仅仅归因于迭代检索或推理,并且通过语义地形学明确组织检索到的证据对多跳推理性能有实质性贡献.

blocks.en: E.2 Comparison of Subgraph Selection Strategies
blocks.zh: E.2 子图选择策略比较

blocks.en: We further investigate whether the advantage of EDP arises specifically from its topology-aware evidence propagation rather than merely from selecting a connected subgraph. We compare EDP against two standard graph traversal strategies, breadth-first search (BFS) and depth-first search (DFS), as well as a condition without subgraph-based selection. All variants operate on the same candidate graph and use an identical evidence budget; only the evidence selection strategy is changed.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查EDP的优势是否具体来自其地形认知的证据传播,而不是仅仅来自选择一个相连的子图. 我们比较EDP与两个标准的图轨策略,广度第一搜索(BFS)和深度第一搜索(DFS),以及一个没有子图选择的条件. 所有变体都使用相同的候选图表,并使用相同的证据预算;只有证据选择策略有所改变.

blocks.en: Table 7: Comparison of evidence selection strategies on MuSiQue using LLaMA3-8B-Instruct. All methods use the same candidate graph and evidence budget.
blocks.zh: 表7:使用LLaMA3-8B-指令比较MuSiQue的证据选择策略. 所有方法都使用相同的候选图表和证据预算.

blocks.en: Table 7 shows that both BFS and DFS underperform EDP, with absolute EM decreases of 0.030 and 0.022, respectively. The no-subgraph condition exhibits an even larger decrease of 0.038. Fixed-depth traversal strategies are constrained by local graph exploration: BFS tends to expand broadly within a limited depth, whereas DFS follows individual structural branches. In contrast, EDP propagates energy jointly from multiple query-relevant anchors over the graph, allowing evidence distributed across distant regions to contribute to the final selection. This property is particularly useful for MuSiQue, where answering a question often requires aggregating evidence across 2–4 reasoning hops.
blocks.zh: 表7显示,BFS和外勤部的EDP都表现不佳,EM的绝对减少分别为0.030和0.022。 无子图条件显示下降幅度更大,为0.038。 固定的深度横贯战略受到当地图解勘探的制约: 业务流程服务往往在有限深度范围内广泛扩展,而外勤部则遵循个别结构分支。 与此相反,电子数据交换方案通过多个与查询有关的主锚在图表上联合传播能量,使分布在遥远区域的证据能够对最后选择作出贡献。 这种财产对MuSiQue特别有用, 回答一个问题往往需要从2–4个推理跳跃中收集证据。

blocks.en: E.3 Intrinsic Evaluation of Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: E.3 语义分裂的内在评价

blocks.en: In addition to the downstream ablation reported in the main paper, we directly evaluate the boundary prediction quality of the semantic segmentation model. We construct an independent held-out evaluation set containing 50 Wikipedia documents that are disjoint from the 100 documents used to train the boundary predictor. Teacher-generated semantic boundaries are used as reference annotations, resulting in 719 reference boundaries in total.
blocks.zh: 除了主论文中报告的下游衰减外,我们直接评价语义分解模型的边界预测质量. 我们构建了一套独立的搁置评估,包含50个维基百科文件,它们与用来训练边界预测器的100个文件脱节。 教师生成的语义边界被用作参考说明,导致总计719个参考边界.

blocks.en: Table 8: Intrinsic evaluation of the semantic boundary predictor on 50 held-out Wikipedia documents. Scores measure agreement with teacher-generated reference boundaries.
blocks.zh: 表8 维基百科中的相关条目: 对50个被搁置的维基百科文件中语义边界预测器的内在评价 分数测量协议与老师生成的参考边界.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 8 , the lightweight boundary predictor achieves a precision of 0.948, recall of 0.861, and F1 score of 0.902. The high precision indicates that the model rarely introduces unsupported semantic breaks, while the recall suggests that most reference boundaries are successfully identified. Together with the downstream performance reported in the main paper, these results provide complementary evidence that the learned segmentation model can preserve coherent semantic units without relying on dataset-specific retraining.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,轻量级边界预测器的精度为0.948,召回0.861,F1得分为0.902. 高精度表示模型很少引入无支持的语义断裂,而召回则表示大多数参考边界被成功识别. 这些结果与主要论文中报告的下游绩效一起,提供了补充证据,证明学习的分解模型可以保留连贯的语义单元,而无需依赖数据集特有的再培训.

blocks.en: Appendix G Qualitative Error Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录G 定性 错误分析

blocks.en: Figure 6: Distribution of failure modes analyzed from 200 incorrect predictions.
blocks.zh: 图6:从200个不正确的预测中分析了故障模式的分布情况。

blocks.en: To systematically investigate the boundary conditions and inherent limitations of the ThreadRAG framework, we conducted a rigorous qualitative error analysis on the HotpotQA dataset (in Figure 6 ). Specifically, we randomly sampled 200 incorrect prediction cases from the evaluation pool and manually scrutinized their underlying reasoning traces. These failures were comprehensively classified into three distinct categories based on their root causes: • Retrieval Failure (74.5%, 149 cases): This dominant failure mode occurs when the upstream initial retriever fails to surface any documents containing the gold supporting evidence within the top- k k retrieval pool. Consequently, the subsequently constructed Semantic Topology Graph (STG) lacks the necessary factual foundation, rendering correct deduction impossible. • LLM Analysis Error (21.0%, 42 cases): In this scenario, the ThreadRAG pipeline functions flawlessly, successfully linearizing a perfect, context-intact prompt that encapsulates the complete multi-hop reasoning chain. However, the downstream baseline Large Language Model suffers from intrinsic logical deficiencies or hallucinations during the final step, failing to deduce the correct target answer despite having access to the pristine context. • Pathfinding Error (4.5%, 9 cases): This represents the internal boundary condition of our system. During exceptionally long-range or complex multi-hop path exploration, the energy propagated via our Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP) module decays beyond acceptable margins, or falls slightly below the rigid structural pruning threshold. As a result, critical evidence nodes are inadvertently truncated or filtered out during the topological linearization phase.

blocks.en: This empirical breakdown of failure modes strongly validates the efficacy, robustness, and architectural soundness of our proposed Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP) mechanism. The statistical distribution clearly illustrates that a staggering 95.5% of the total failure cases are exclusively triggered by orthogonal, external bottlenecks—namely, the hard recall limits of the upstream retriever and the intrinsic reasoning ceilings of the baseline LLM. In sharp contrast, errors stemming from our internal graph pathfinding and structural pruning components constitute an absolute minority (merely 4.5%). These quantitative insights demonstrate that the EDP module successfully navigates complex knowledge topologies to eliminate redundant context noise while maintaining an exceptionally high fidelity in preserving critical factual chains for downstream generation.
